split_method: Fixed topic split by source chapter before retrieval; no random seed is used.
filter_policy: Chapter is supplied explicitly in the question before retrieval. A/B ignore filters; C applies the supplied filter. C uses no filter when filter is null. Never derive filters from gold source/page/answer.

strategy_comparisons.A_vs_B: Change chunking only; same metadata and no filters.
strategy_comparisons.B_vs_C: Identical chunks and embeddings; change supplied metadata filtering only.

selection_criteria_in_order.direction: ascending alphabetical order for exact remaining ties

selection_policy: Tune and select on dev only. Freeze final strategy configurations before running test. Grounding/coherence/metadata audits explain the choice and limitations; they do not trigger test-driven tuning.

evidence_policy.required_hit: A single returned chunk must match an accepted source/page and contain the complete evidence quote after NFC and whitespace folding, or equivalent sufficient evidence explicitly confirmed in an audit.
evidence_policy.alternatives: Accept any listed primary or alternative gold evidence. A newly discovered equivalent passage must be recorded as an explicit audit override with source/page/quote, reason and reviewer; apply the same rule across all strategies without tuning on test.
evidence_policy.split_evidence: Evidence spread across multiple chunks is a failure under the required single-chunk metric; optional multi-chunk analysis must be reported separately.
evidence_policy.reporting: Report Hit@1 and Evidence Hit@3 by split with numerator and denominator; keep full top-3 traces.
evidence_policy.offsets: 0-based Python Unicode character offsets in normalized page text; end offset is exclusive.

coherence_sampling.page_policy: First 10 included corpus pages sorted by document_id and numeric physical PDF page.
coherence_sampling.position_policy: First paragraph of at least 100 characters on each page. Reference is first 160 characters of that paragraph. Anchor is paragraph start + min(80, paragraph length - 1).
coherence_sampling.chunk_selection: Among chunks containing the anchor offset, choose the chunk whose midpoint is closest to the anchor; tie by smallest start_char, then chunk_id. Use the same positions for A/B/C.
coherence_sampling.missing_coverage: Record as missing coverage with coherence 0 and a reason; do not silently drop the sample.

scale.0: Cut meaning or missing subject makes it unintelligible
scale.2: Self-contained and preserves a complete idea

coherence_sampling.limitation: The deterministic first-10-page sample covers early chapters only; it is not representative of all six chapters.

future_manual_audits.metadata: Inspect all returned top-3 records for the 5 test questions per strategy; report correct-and-complete n/N. Report filter compliance separately, or N/A if no filter questions.
future_manual_audits.grounding: For each of 5 test questions per strategy, score top-3 evidence 0/1/2 with reasons; report counts per level and mean /2. This is evidence sufficiency, not LLM answer accuracy.
future_manual_audits.coherence: Apply the fixed 10 positions and 0/1/2 scale; publish selected chunks and reasons.

review_method: Questions, answers and evidence were authored and checked with Codex assistance. Source containment is checked programmatically; answer support is reviewed by the AI-assisted author, not an independent human judge. No retrieval scores or manual retrieval-audit labels exist yet.
limitations: One English book and only 20 questions; test contains only 5 questions from two chapters.
Chapter-level split reduces topic overlap, but all questions share one book and basic concepts such as loops/functions recur across chapters.
The author necessarily knows test questions during dataset creation; the holdout refers to no test-based tuning, not author blindness.
Filter scopes are explicit chapter requests for this educational corpus; do not generalize filter gains to ambiguous user requests.
Historical Python edition: avoid claims about current dictionary ordering and range return types; benchmark only supported stable behavior.
No unanswerable questions are included in required metrics. Diagrams are not used as sole evidence.
